items.name: narrator-hearth
items.speaker: speaker.narrator
items.description: An old woman storyteller in her seventies: a warm, low alto voice, gentle and kind, with a faint husky grain, slow and deliberate. She speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, clearly and unhurried, close to the microphone in a quiet room, as if telling a tale to children by lantern light.
items.text:
Under the canopy, every colony keeps one law above the rest: the Queen tends the brood.

Aurelith had worn the crown for a single winter. From the high balconies of the Spire she could watch her whole colony wake: workers at the amber stores, soldiers at the gates, nurses carrying the young up into the light.
